summary: Iteration 27 regression tests passed. Verified: (1) AdminDashboard filter-upcoming / filter-past buttons present and clickable alongside filter-all/filter-deposits-held. (2) /api/admin/stripe-live-check reads STRIPE_API_KEY via secrets_store and returns key_prefix starting with 'sk_test_' (not empty as the original bug). (3) /api/admin/dayof-reminders/preview returns schedule 'Daily at 12:00 AM Nassau time', today[] list, and last_run. (4) /api/admin/dayof-reminders/send-now requires CSRF — POST without X-CSRF-Token header is rejected (403). With CSRF it returns the run dict with count + guest_reminders_sent. (5) send_guest_reminders idempotency unit test with real Mongo + mocked notifications confirms second call skips already-reminded TEST booking. Test doc deleted. (6) UI: Admin login completes, sessionStorage.admin_csrf is set (len=43) and sessionStorage.admin_email populated. (7) Admin Manage → Owner SMS tab shows dayof-reminders-card above payment-digest-card with dayof-schedule, dayof-today-list, dayof-send-now-btn, dayof-last-run testids. 'Last run' timestamp was already populated from earlier cron tick.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' repeats multiple times — chart container size evaluating before mount. Non-blocking cosmetic console noise.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/dayof_reminders.py send_guest_reminders uses atomic $exists guard — good idempotency pattern.
stripe_live_check in admin.py imports secrets_store.get_secret lazily inside the handler — correct for live DB override lookup.
frontend/src/lib/api.js axios interceptor correctly falls back to sessionStorage.admin_csrf when cookie is missing (cross-origin www.roxtaxi.com case).
AdminLogin stores csrf_token in sessionStorage only when response contains it — defensive null-check present.
Minor: Recharts width/height(-1) warnings in Owner SMS panel suggest a chart container w/o explicit min dimensions; cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Idempotency test creates TEST_dayof_<uuid> booking and deletes it in finally block — no residual TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_27.json documents dayof-reminders + stripe-live-check + CSRF fallback regression. Reusable backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_iter27_dayof_csrf_stripe.py (5 tests, all pass). CSRF double-submit enforcement verified.
